The star-shaped hubs on the spools lack sharp, mechanical precision. The edges appear slightly soft and irregular, lacking the crisp molding lines expected of manufactured plastic parts.
The magnetic tape within the central rectangular window appears as a uniform dark void without distinct layers or tension, lacking the physical depth and layering of real wound tape.
